Summary: Create monorepo (api, tenant-web, admin-web, shared packages)
Description: pnpm/Turborepo (or Nx) monorepo with apps/api (NestJS), apps/tenant-web and apps/admin-web (React + Vite), packages/shared (types, event contracts, permission keys).
Acceptance Criteria:
- All three apps build and start from one command
- Shared package imported by api and both web apps
- README documents layout and scripts

Summary: Lint, format, commit hooks and TypeScript strict mode
Description: ESLint + Prettier + strict tsconfig across the repo, lint-staged on pre-commit, conventional commits.
Acceptance Criteria:
- `pnpm lint` passes clean
- Pre-commit hook blocks unformatted code

Summary: Docker Compose for Postgres 16 + Redis + Mailpit
Description: Local stack with seeded .env.example. Mailpit catches outgoing email in dev.
Acceptance Criteria:
- `docker compose up` gives working Postgres, Redis and mail inbox
- API connects using .env.example defaults

Summary: Choose ORM + migration tool and wire into NestJS
Description: Decide between Prisma, Drizzle, TypeORM or Kysely. Must support raw SQL for RLS policies and SET LOCAL per transaction. Record decision as an ADR.
Acceptance Criteria:
- ADR written in /docs/adr
- First migration runs up and down
- Transaction helper can execute `SET LOCAL app.current_tenant`

Summary: CI pipeline: lint, typecheck, test, build
Description: GitHub Actions running on every PR with a Postgres + Redis service container for integration tests.
Acceptance Criteria:
- PRs show green/red checks
- Integration tests run against real Postgres in CI

Summary: Test harness: unit, integration and e2e
Description: Jest/Vitest for units, Supertest integration tests with per-test DB transaction rollback, Playwright for web e2e. Factories for tenants/users.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Sample test of each kind passes in CI
- Test factories create a tenant + owner in one call

Description: @nestjs/config with zod validation; app refuses to boot on missing/invalid env.
Acceptance Criteria: - Missing required env var fails fast with clear message

Summary: Architecture Decision Records + coding conventions doc
Description: Capture the core decisions already made (modular monolith, shared schema + RLS, vertical→core dependency rule) as ADRs.
Acceptance Criteria:
- ADR-001..004 committed
- CONTRIBUTING.md explains module boundaries

Summary: UI kit and design tokens for both web apps
Description: Pick a component library (e.g. shadcn/ui + Tailwind or Mantine), define tokens, layout shell, tables, forms, dialogs. Shared across tenant and admin apps.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Storybook or equivalent showing core components
- Both apps consume the same UI package

Description: tenants(id, name, slug, business_type, status, timezone, currency, created_at). Base columns (id UUID, tenant_id, created_at/by, updated_at/by, deleted_at) for all tenant-scoped tables.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Migration creates tenants
- Base entity/mixin documented and used by a sample table

Summary: Postgres Row-Level Security on every tenant-scoped table
Description: Non-superuser app DB role; RLS policy `tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')::uuid`; FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY. Migration helper that adds tenant_id + policy in one call.
Acceptance Criteria:
- App connects as a role without BYPASSRLS
- Query without tenant context returns zero rows
- Helper used by every new tenant table migration
- Lint/CI check fails if a tenant table lacks a policy

Description: Resolve tenant from JWT claim (and subdomain later). Interceptor opens a transaction and runs SET LOCAL app.current_tenant; AsyncLocalStorage exposes tenantId/userId to services.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Every tenant request runs inside a tenant-scoped transaction
- Background jobs can run with an explicit tenant context
- Connection pool never leaks a tenant setting between requests (test)

Description: Automated tests creating two tenants and asserting no read/write crosses over for every tenant-scoped endpoint.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Test auto-discovers tenant tables and fails if any row leaks
- Runs in CI on every PR

Description: users (global identity) + tenant_memberships(user_id, tenant_id, role_id, status). One user can belong to multiple tenants. Argon2 password hashing.
Acceptance Criteria:
- User can sign up via invite and log in
- Same email can be member of two tenants
- Passwords hashed with argon2id

Summary: JWT access + refresh tokens with Redis session store
Description: Short-lived access token carrying user_id, tenant_id, membership_id; rotating refresh tokens stored in Redis for instant revocation.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Refresh rotation with reuse detection
- Logout revokes session immediately
- Tenant switcher issues a new token for another membership

Summary: Password reset, email verification and invites
Description: Signed single-use tokens emailed via transactional mail provider; owner invites staff by email.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Reset link expires after 1 hour and single use
- Invited user lands in the correct tenant

Description: TOTP enrolment with recovery codes; tenant setting to require MFA for owners/managers.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Owner can enable/disable TOTP
- Recovery codes work once each

Summary: modules + tenant_modules tables with dependency graph
Description: modules(key, name, category core|optional|vertical, depends_on[]); tenant_modules(tenant_id, module_key, enabled, config JSONB). Seed core module rows.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Enabling a module auto-enables or rejects on missing dependencies
- Disabling a module with dependents is rejected with a clear message

Description: Every controller declares its module; the guard checks the tenant's enabled set from Redis key tenant:{id}:modules, refreshed on change.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Calling a disabled module's route returns 403 MODULE_DISABLED
- Cache invalidated within 1s of a module toggle
- Controller without @RequiresModule fails a CI check

Description: Each module registers a zod schema for its tenant_modules.config; settings API validates against it.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Invalid config rejected with field errors
- Defaults applied when config is empty

Description: Code-defined permission catalogue (e.g. sales.order.create, sales.refund, inventory.adjust). roles + role_permissions per tenant. Seed Owner and Staff roles.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Permission keys live in packages/shared and are type-safe
- New tenant gets Owner + Staff roles

Description: Guard checks the membership's effective permissions (cached tenant:{id}:role:{rid}).
Acceptance Criteria:
- Missing permission returns 403 with the permission key
- Role change reflected on next request

Description: Typed event envelope (id, type, version, tenantId, occurredAt, actor, payload) in packages/shared. EventEmitter2 in-process now; handlers are idempotent by event id.
Acceptance Criteria:
- OrderCompleted-style sample event emitted and handled in a test
- Handler failure does not roll back the emitter's transaction
- Event contracts versioned

Description: Write events to an outbox table in the same transaction as the state change; a relay publishes them. Makes the later BullMQ/Kafka switch a transport change only.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Event is never published if the transaction rolls back
- Relay retries until handled; processed events marked

Description: Append-only audit_log(tenant_id, actor, action, entity, entity_id, before/after JSON, ip, at) written by an interceptor/service for mutating actions.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Create/update/delete of core entities produce audit rows
- Audit rows cannot be updated or deleted by the app role

Description: Gap-safe, per-tenant counters for ORD-, INV-, RCPT-, PO- with configurable prefix and padding.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Concurrent requests never produce duplicate numbers
- Prefix configurable per tenant

Description: S3-compatible storage (S3/R2/MinIO locally) with tenant-prefixed keys and signed URLs; used for receipts, logos, product images.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Upload + signed download works
- Files of one tenant cannot be fetched by another

Description: Integer minor units (sen) everywhere, currency per tenant, banker's vs half-up rounding decision, Malaysian 5-sen cash rounding helper.
Acceptance Criteria:
- No floats for money anywhere (lint rule or type)
- Rounding helper unit-tested

Summary: API conventions: errors, pagination, filtering, OpenAPI
Description: Standard error shape, cursor pagination, list filter/sort params, Swagger generated, typed client generated for the web apps.
Acceptance Criteria:
- OpenAPI served at /docs
- Web apps use a generated client

Description: Idempotency-Key header stored in Redis with the response; used on order/payment endpoints to survive flaky shop Wi-Fi.
Acceptance Criteria: - Replaying a request with the same key returns the original response and creates nothing

Summary: Tenant app shell, login and module-driven navigation
Description: On login fetch {tenant, enabledModules, permissions, businessType}; build sidebar and routes from it. Lazy-load module route chunks.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Disabled module is absent from nav and its routes 404
- <Can permission=...> component hides unauthorized actions
- Tenant switcher for multi-tenant users

Summary: Platform admin app shell with separate auth
Description: Separate React app; platform_admins table and auth stack independent of tenant users; no RLS bypass by default.
Acceptance Criteria: - Tenant credentials cannot log into admin app and vice versa

Description: business_type_templates rows holding default modules, module config, roles, tax settings, product categories and order workflow. Applied on tenant creation.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Creating an Optical tenant yields the right modules, categories and workflow
- Template can be re-applied to a blank tenant in dev

Description: Single service that creates tenant, owner membership, roles, applies template and seeds numbering. Public signup form calls it.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Signup to first login under 1 minute
- Provisioning is transactional: failure leaves nothing behind

Summary: Business settings: profile, logo, address, tax ID, timezone, currency
Description: Settings page + API for business profile used on receipts and invoices (SSM number, SST number, address).
Acceptance Criteria:
- Settings appear on printed receipt
- Timezone used for all date boundaries in reports

Description: locations table with one default location; orders and stock reference location_id from day one so multi-location is not a retrofit.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Every order and stock row has a location_id
- UI hides location picker while tenant has one location

Description: Name, phone (E.164, Malaysian default), email, IC/DOB optional, address, notes. Fast search by name/phone; duplicate-phone warning.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Create/edit/archive customer
- Search returns results under 200ms for 10k customers
- Duplicate phone warns before save

Summary: Customer 360 page: orders, payments, balance, prescriptions
Description: Single page showing contact info, order history, outstanding balance, prescription history (if module enabled) and notes timeline.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Outstanding balance matches sum of unpaid order balances
- Prescription tab only visible with optical module

Description: Record marketing consent and consent date; owner can export or anonymise a customer (Malaysia PDPA).
Acceptance Criteria:
- Anonymise keeps financial records but strips PII
- Consent flag respected by future marketing features

Description: Categories (tree) each with an attribute set: Frame(brand, model, colour, size, gender, material), Lens(index, coating, type), Contact lens(BC, DIA, power). Stored as typed JSONB validated by schema.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Owner can define attributes per category
- Product form renders fields from the category's attribute set
- Template seeds optical categories

Description: Product with variants (e.g. frame colour/size), SKU, barcode, cost price, selling price, tax class, track-stock flag, service/non-stock items (e.g. eye exam, fitting fee).
Acceptance Criteria:
- Barcode scan in search finds the variant
- Non-stock items never affect stock
- Price history kept on change

Summary: Stock levels and stock movement ledger
Description: stock_movements append-only (type, qty, ref, cost, location); stock_levels derived/maintained per variant per location. Reservations tracked separately from on-hand.
Acceptance Criteria:
- On-hand = sum of movements (reconciliation test)
- Every change has a movement row with reason and reference

Description: Receive stock (qty + unit cost) and adjust with reason codes (damaged, count correction, lost). Temporary substitute for purchasing in MVP.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Adjustment requires reason
- Receive updates average cost
- Emits StockAdjusted event

Description: Reorder level per variant; dashboard widget + in-app notification when crossed.
Acceptance Criteria: - Crossing threshold creates one notification, not one per sale

Summary: CSV import for products and customers
Description: Upload CSV, map columns, preview with validation errors, import in background.
Acceptance Criteria:
- 1,000-row file imports with row-level error report
- Re-import with same SKU updates rather than duplicates

Description: Generate printable barcode labels (Code128/EAN) for selected variants.
Acceptance Criteria: - PDF sheet of labels for chosen products

Summary: Extensible order model: header, lines, totals
Description: orders + order_lines with price, discount, tax per line; totals, deposit, paid, balance. Orders can be immediate (walk-in sale) or long-running (optical job). extension JSONB + 1:1 extension tables allowed for verticals.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Totals computed server-side and re-verified on save
- Walk-in sale and multi-stage order use the same model
- Core order code contains no optical terms

Description: Per-tenant workflow definition (states, allowed transitions, required permission, side-effects as event names). Optical default: Created → Deposit paid → Frame reserved → Lens ordered → Lens received → Assembly → QC → Ready → Notified → Picked up → Completed. Status history table.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Illegal transitions rejected
- Every transition recorded with user and timestamp
- Template provides optical and simple-retail workflows

Description: Fast keyboard + barcode driven screen: pick customer, add items, discounts, take full payment or deposit. Works on a tablet.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Walk-in sale completed in under 30 seconds
- Barcode scanner input adds item
- Deposit order leaves correct balance

Description: Kanban by status + filterable list (status, due date, customer, staff). Overdue highlighting.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Drag or button moves order to next allowed status
- Overdue orders flagged by promised date

Summary: Payments: cash, card, e-wallet/DuitNow QR (manual record)
Description: payments table (method, amount, reference, received_by); multiple partial payments per order; change calculation for cash with 5-sen rounding.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Deposit + balance payments tracked separately
- Balance can never go negative without explicit overpayment handling
- Emits PaymentReceived

Description: 80mm thermal receipt layout + A4 invoice PDF with business details, SST breakdown and balance due. Reprint anytime.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Receipt prints from browser to thermal printer
- PDF invoice emailable to customer

Summary: Line and order discounts with permission limits
Description: Percent or fixed discounts; max discount per role; manager override flow.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Staff above limit needs manager PIN/approval
- Discount reason recorded

Description: Tax classes per product, rate table per tenant, inclusive/exclusive toggle. Default Malaysian SST setup with option to disable for non-registered businesses.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Tax computed per line and summed correctly
- Non-SST-registered tenant shows no tax lines

Description: Cancel order (releases reservations) and refund payments (full/partial) with reason; returns items to stock optionally.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Refund requires sales.refund permission
- Refund reverses ledger and stock via events

Summary: Stock reservation on order + deduction on completion
Description: Reserving (e.g. frame reserved) holds stock; completion/pickup emits OrderCompleted and inventory deducts through an event handler.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Reserved stock not sellable to others
- Handler is idempotent (replay safe)

Description: vertical-extensions/optical: prescriptions per customer with SPH/CYL/AXIS/ADD/PRISM/PD per eye, VA, examiner, date, expiry, notes. Validation of ranges and 0.25 steps.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Rx history per customer, newest first
- Invalid values rejected (e.g. axis outside 0–180)
- Module disabled = zero optical UI or routes

Summary: Attach prescription to order + lens job details
Description: order_prescriptions 1:1 extension table; lens job fields (lens type, index, coatings, fitting heights, frame measurements). Printed on job card.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Order can link one Rx snapshot (copied, not referenced, so later edits don't change it)
- Core sales module does not import optical code (lint rule)

Description: Printable workshop sheet with Rx, frame, lens specs, due date and barcode of order number.
Acceptance Criteria: - Scanning job card barcode opens the order

Description: Exam notes, visual acuity, IOP optional, chargeable exam service item that can be added to an order.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Exam produces an Rx draft
- Exam fee added to order in one click

Summary: Rx expiry / annual check-up reminders list
Description: List of customers whose last exam is older than N months, for follow-up calls (automation comes in P9).
Acceptance Criteria: - Filter by months since last exam, exportable CSV

Summary: Append-only ledger postings for sales, payments, expenses
Description: Minimal chart of accounts (Cash, Bank, AR, Revenue, SST payable, Inventory, COGS, Expenses) and journal_entries/lines written by event handlers. Must balance (debits = credits).
Acceptance Criteria:
- Every sale, payment, refund and expense produces a balanced entry
- Entries are immutable; corrections are reversals
- DB constraint or check prevents unbalanced entries

Summary: Expense entries with categories and receipt upload
Description: Category, amount, date, payment method, vendor text, note, receipt photo. Default categories from template (rent, utilities, salaries...).
Acceptance Criteria:
- Expense posts to ledger via event
- Receipt image viewable from list

Summary: Cash drawer sessions (open/close shift, cash count)
Description: Open with float, record pay-ins/outs, close with counted cash; variance report.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Close shows expected vs counted and variance
- Payments linked to the open session

Description: By day and payment method, with totals, discounts, refunds, tax; date range filter respecting tenant timezone.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Matches sum of payments for the day
- Exports CSV

Description: On-hand, reserved, available, cost value per variant and category.
Acceptance Criteria: - Stock value = qty × average cost

Description: Orders with unpaid balance, age in days, customer contact.
Acceptance Criteria: - Sum equals total AR in ledger

Description: Month view: revenue, COGS, expenses, gross and net profit from the ledger.
Acceptance Criteria: - Numbers derive only from ledger, not from orders table

Description: Today's sales, orders due today, ready-for-pickup count, low stock, outstanding balance; widgets appear only for enabled modules.
Acceptance Criteria: - Widgets respect module + permission

Summary: In-app notifications + email on order ready
Description: Notification center for staff; customer email when order reaches Ready. Template per event with tenant branding.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Order → Ready sends one email to customer (if email present)
- Staff sees bell notifications for low stock and overdue orders

Description: Button generating a wa.me link with prefilled 'Your glasses are ready' message. Zero-integration stopgap before WhatsApp API.
Acceptance Criteria: - Message template editable in settings

Summary: Fixed Owner / Manager / Staff role maps
Description: Hardcoded permission sets per role for MVP; user management page to invite and assign roles.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Staff cannot see cost price, reports or settings
- Owner can deactivate a user

Summary: List tenants, view status/plan, toggle modules
Description: Tenant list with status (trial/active/suspended), user count, created date; detail page to toggle modules and suspend. Reads tenant metadata only, not business data.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Toggling a module is reflected in tenant app within seconds
- Suspended tenant cannot log in and sees a notice

Summary: Create tenant from admin with template
Description: Admin-side onboarding form calling the provisioning service; sends owner invite.
Acceptance Criteria: - Tenant created and owner invited without SQL

Summary: First-run setup wizard for new tenants
Description: Business details → tax → first staff → import products/customers → done checklist.
Acceptance Criteria: - New owner reaches first sale without help docs

Description: Script generating realistic customers, frames, lenses, orders across statuses for demos and testing.
Acceptance Criteria: - `pnpm seed:demo` produces a believable shop

Description: Pick hosting (e.g. Fly.io/Render/Railway or AWS ap-southeast-1/5 for Malaysian latency), managed Postgres + Redis, staging and production, IaC where practical.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Staging auto-deploys from main
- Production deploy is one approved action
- Region close to Malaysia

Description: Expand/contract migrations, migration step in deploy pipeline, rollback plan.
Acceptance Criteria: - Deploy with a schema change causes no downtime in staging test

Summary: Backups, point-in-time recovery and restore drill
Description: Automated daily backups + PITR; documented and tested restore; per-tenant export script.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Restore drill completed and timed
- Single-tenant export produces full data dump

Description: Structured logs with tenant_id/request_id, Sentry for api + web, basic metrics dashboard, uptime check and alerting.
Acceptance Criteria:
- An exception in production reaches Sentry with tenant context
- Alert fires on 5xx spike

Description: Helmet/CSP, CORS, rate limiting on auth, dependency scanning, secret scanning, OWASP ASVS checklist, RLS review.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Checklist completed and filed
- No high-severity dependency alerts open

Description: @nestjs/throttler with Redis store; stricter limits on auth endpoints.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Brute force on login is throttled
- One noisy tenant can't exhaust shared limits

Summary: Terms of service, privacy policy, PDPA notice
Description: Customer-facing legal docs; data processing terms since tenants store their customers' data.
Acceptance Criteria: - Docs linked from signup and app footer

Description: Load test POS and order list with 50 tenants × realistic data; add indexes (tenant_id first) and fix N+1s.
Acceptance Criteria: - p95 < 300ms for POS endpoints at target load

Description: Installable PWA, tablet-first POS layout, graceful offline message (true offline mode is P10).
Acceptance Criteria:
- Installs on iPad/Android tablet
- POS usable at 768px width

Description: Short docs/videos for top 10 tasks; link from each screen.
Acceptance Criteria: - Top 10 tasks documented

Description: Migrate the pilot shop's products and customers, train staff, run in parallel with existing process for two weeks, collect feedback into backlog.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Shop runs a full week of real orders in BOS
- Feedback captured as tickets

Description: Feedback widget and privacy-respecting usage analytics (PostHog etc.) keyed by tenant, not customer data.
Acceptance Criteria: - Feedback lands in an inbox the team reads

Summary: Extract optical assumptions out of core modules
Description: Audit Sales/Inventory/Customers for optical-specific fields or logic and move them into vertical-extensions/optical.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Dependency-cruiser rule: core never imports vertical-extensions — enforced in CI
- Optical still works end to end

Summary: Vertical extension SDK: hooks, slots and extension tables
Description: Documented way for a vertical to add: 1:1 extension tables, event handlers, workflow side-effects, UI slots (e.g. order detail panel, customer tab), settings pages.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Optical re-implemented purely through the SDK
- Guide for adding a new vertical

Description: Templates move to versioned JSON/YAML with validation; later edited in platform admin.
Acceptance Criteria: - Adding a template needs no code change

Description: Clothing: size/colour variants matrix; General Retail: plain POS workflow.
Acceptance Criteria: - New tenant of each type works without optical UI

Description: Areas, tables, seats; open tab per table; move/merge tables.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Order can be opened against a table
- Floor plan shows occupied/free

Description: Modifier groups (size, add-ons, spice level) with price deltas; required/optional rules.
Acceptance Criteria: - Modifiers appear on kitchen ticket and receipt

Description: Send order to kitchen by station; KDS screen with bump; kitchen ticket printing.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Order lines route to the right station
- Bumped items update order status

Description: Recipe (BOM) per menu item; OrderCompleted deducts ingredients instead of the item.
Acceptance Criteria: - Selling 1 nasi lemak deducts its ingredients

Description: Split by item or evenly; configurable service charge.
Acceptance Criteria: - Split bills reconcile to the original total

Description: If Salon chosen as 2nd vertical instead: staff calendars, services with duration, booking → order conversion.
Acceptance Criteria: - Booking can be converted to a sale with the booked services

Summary: Supplier profiles, contacts and supplied products
Description: Supplier master, multiple contacts, payment terms, supplier SKU and price per product.
Acceptance Criteria: - Product shows its suppliers and last cost

Description: Staff raise requests; manager approves into a PO. Also generated from low-stock.
Acceptance Criteria: - Approved request converts to PO

Description: Create/send PO (PDF/email), statuses draft/sent/partially received/received/closed.
Acceptance Criteria:
- PO PDF emailed to supplier
- Status reflects receipts

Description: Receive against PO lines, partial quantities, updates stock and cost via GoodsReceived event.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Partial receipt leaves remaining qty open
- Stock + average cost updated

Description: Record supplier bill, 3-way match (PO/GRN/bill), pay fully or partially; posts to AP.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Mismatch flagged
- Supplier balance correct

Summary: Auto-create lens order to lab from job
Description: "Lens ordered" status can generate a PO to the lens lab with Rx details; receipt moves order to "Lens received".
Acceptance Criteria: - Receiving the lens PO advances the linked order

Description: Enable multiple branches/warehouses; stock per location; POS sells from its location.
Acceptance Criteria: - Each branch sees its own availability plus others read-only

Description: Transfer out → in transit → received, with discrepancies.
Acceptance Criteria: - In-transit stock not sellable at either end

Description: Freeze snapshot, count via scanner, review variances, post adjustments.
Acceptance Criteria: - Variance report before posting

Description: Track contact lens batches with expiry; serials for electronics; FEFO suggestions.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Expiring batch report
- Serial captured at sale

Description: Per-tenant costing method; COGS posted from cost layers.
Acceptance Criteria: - Valuation report ties to Inventory account in ledger

Description: Suggest PO quantities from sales velocity and reorder levels.
Acceptance Criteria: - Suggested PO can be created in one click

Description: Default Malaysian SME chart; tenants can add accounts; mapping of event postings to accounts configurable.
Acceptance Criteria: - Posting rules editable without code

Summary: Manual journal entries and period locking
Description: Accountant can post adjusting journals; lock closed periods.
Acceptance Criteria: - Posting into locked period rejected

Description: Statements for any period with comparison; drill down to entries.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Balance sheet balances
- Drill-down from line to journal

Description: Direct method from cash/bank accounts.
Acceptance Criteria: - Closing cash equals cash account balance

Summary: AR and AP aging + customer statements
Description: 0–30/31–60/61–90/90+ aging; printable customer statements.
Acceptance Criteria: - Aging totals equal AR/AP balances

Description: Import bank CSV, match to payments/expenses, reconcile.
Acceptance Criteria: - Unmatched lines listed; reconciled balance matches statement

Description: Taxable sales, tax collected per period in the shape needed for the SST return.
Acceptance Criteria: - Figures reconcile to SST payable account

Description: Confirm current mandate phases and exemption thresholds for SMEs, consolidated e-invoice rules for B2C, API vs portal options and sandbox access.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Written summary of what tenants must do and when
- Decision on build vs third-party middleware

Description: Submit invoices/credit notes via MyInvois API, store UUID + validation QR, monthly consolidated e-invoice for B2C receipts, buyer TIN capture.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Invoice validated in sandbox with QR on PDF
- Consolidated monthly submission job

Summary: Export to external accounting (CSV / SQL Account / Xero)
Description: Many SMEs keep an accountant: export journals in common formats.
Acceptance Criteria: - Export imports cleanly into target tool

Description: Monthly rent etc. auto-created; expenses above threshold need approval.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Recurring schedule creates entries on time
- Unapproved expenses not posted

Description: Staff submit claims with receipts; approve and reimburse.
Acceptance Criteria: - Reimbursement posts to ledger

Summary: Custom roles and permission matrix UI
Description: Owner creates roles and ticks permissions per module (View/Create/Edit/Delete/Refund/Adjust...), grouped by enabled modules.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Custom role takes effect immediately
- Cannot remove own last owner permission

Description: Hide sensitive fields by permission across API responses and UI.
Acceptance Criteria: - Cost price absent from API payload for roles without it

Description: Restrict users to specific branches.
Acceptance Criteria: - User sees only assigned branches' orders and stock

Description: Employee profile (position, IC, start date, salary info optional), optionally linked to a user login.
Acceptance Criteria: - Employee without login can be assigned to sales

Description: PIN-based clock in at POS, weekly roster, timesheet export.
Acceptance Criteria: - Timesheet shows hours per employee per week

Description: Attribute sales to staff; commission rules by category.
Acceptance Criteria: - Commission report per period

Summary: Quick user switching on shared POS (PIN)
Description: Shared tablet stays logged in to the tenant; staff switch with a PIN so actions are attributed.
Acceptance Criteria: - Every order records the acting staff member

Summary: Plans, module pricing and feature limits
Description: Plans (e.g. Starter/Professional) with included modules, add-on module prices, limits (users, locations).
Acceptance Criteria: - Limits enforced (e.g. 4th user blocked on 3-user plan)

Description: Recurring billing via a gateway supporting Malaysian cards/FPX (e.g. Stripe, Billplz, or similar); trials, upgrades, proration, dunning, invoices to tenants.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Trial converts to paid
- Failed payment → grace period → suspension
- Tenant can download their platform invoices

Summary: Trial lifecycle and self-serve plan management
Description: Trial countdown banners, upgrade from inside tenant app, cancel flow with data export.
Acceptance Criteria: - Cancelled tenant keeps read-only access for N days

Description: Tenant owner grants time-boxed support access; admin gets short-lived session (Redis TTL) with banner; every action logged as 'support on behalf of'.
Acceptance Criteria:
- No access without active grant
- All actions attributable in tenant audit log
- Session auto-expires

Description: Log every platform-admin action (module toggles, suspensions, impersonations).
Acceptance Criteria: - Audit searchable by admin, tenant, action

Description: Least-privilege roles for your own team.
Acceptance Criteria: - Support role cannot change billing

Description: Per-tenant/percentage flags for beta features separate from module entitlements.
Acceptance Criteria: - Feature enabled for one tenant only
